request.description: cpclib-dap only supports launching a fresh session - there is no running process to attach to.

program.description: The .asm, .bas, .sna or .dsk file to debug. A .bas file is tokenised and loaded but not auto-run - type RUN in the emulator once it opens. A .sna is loaded exactly as saved, with no source map - breakpoints and stepping work at the address level only. A .dsk is mounted in drive A at a cold boot, landing at Ready - also not auto-run, and also with no source map.

rule.description: A bndbuild rule that launches the emulator; its 'emu ... run' command is re-issued as 'debug'. Set this instead of `program` to debug a full build.

buildFile.description: The build file `rule` lives in. Defaults to the nearest one.

emulator.description: Which DAP-capable emulator to debug in. Any other value falls back to 1984js with a notice.

watchLabels.description: Labels to report writes to, using the emulator's write-watch channels. The program's own `BREAKPOINT ... TYPE=MEM` directives are watched too, and come first when channels are scarce.

stopOnEntry.description: Break at the address the snapshot starts from, before it runs.

topOfStack.description: Where the program's stack starts - a label or an address. The call stack is walked no further than this. Defaults to a `stack_top`/`stack` label if the program has one.
